name: Religious Studies (Min)

rules.name: Requirements Overview
rules.desc: A minor in Religious Studies requires a minimum of 28 units. Students are encouraged to focus their program of study either on a religious tradition or a theme that cuts across traditions. In consultation with their minor advisor, students may design the minor in Religious Studies to complement their major. The minor must be declared no later than the last day of the quarter, two quarters before degree conferral.

rules.name: Religious Studies Courses - 1-99
rules.desc: Two courses (3-5 units each) from courses numbered RELIGST 1-99, only one of which may be an Introductory Seminar.

rules.name: Religious Studies Courses - 100-289
rules.desc: Three courses (4-5 units each) from courses numbered RELIGST 100-289, of which at least one must be at the 200-level.

rules.name: Remaining Units
rules.desc: The remainder of the coursework needed to bring the total Religious Studies unit count to 28 is chosen in consultation with the student’s minor advisor according to interest.

rules.name: One language course, or other courses the Director of Undergraduate Studies approves
Courses not focused on a single religious tradition

grading: No courses may be taken for the S/NC or CR/NC grade.
policies:
• With the approval of the Director of Undergraduate Studies, one language course relating to the student’s program of study (such as Arabic, Hebrew, Greek, Chinese, Persian, or Japanese), but not counted towards the university language requirement, may be counted towards the minor.

• One course in directed reading (RELIGST 199 Individual Work) may be counted towards the minor.

• Students must ensure their total complement of Religious Studies courses is not focused on a single religious tradition.

• The Director of Undergraduate Studies may approve variations to the required distribution individually.

• All units must be in Religious Studies courses unless an exception is made by the Director of Undergraduate Studies.
transferPolicy: Transfer credit will be considered on a case-by-case basis.
reviewNotes: You take two RELIGST courses numbered 1-99 (at most one Introductory Seminar), three numbered 100-289 (one at the 200 level) and more RELIGST courses to reach 28 units, all letter graded, with at most one directed reading course (RELIGST 199). An approved language course or other exception is moved in by hand, and the spread across religious traditions is checked by hand.
